capability_summary: PROVISIONAL, pending model assessment of the finished report: supplier risk and payment integrity software. Supplier onboarding and vendor master validation, bank account verification, sanctions and PEP screening, improper-payment prevention, and accounts-payable recovery audit for large enterprise and government payment operations.
mission_components: Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service (Do Not Pay, payment integrity, vendor validation)
Defense Finance and Accounting Service (DoD vendor pay, improper payments)
Department of Health and Human Services / CMS (large improper-payment programs)
Department of Veterans Affairs (supplier onboarding and payment integrity)
U.S. Department of Agriculture (improper-payment and vendor management)
General Services Administration (vehicle host and buyer of shared financial services)
_excluded_basis: Company-name collision, not common-noun collision. Store-wide, 'apex' appears in three notice titles and all three are OTHER FIRMS: APEX Gamma Service, APEX Path LLC, Apex Health Group. The bare word is NOT excluded, because that would kill legitimate hits.

discovered_terms_rejected.medical coding: healthcare coding, not payment integrity; leaks in via the 511210 software NAICS
discovered_terms_rejected.accounting services: matched via description boilerplate; top sample is Ice Machine Maintenance
discovered_terms_rejected.financial services: too broad; top sample is S&P market data, not AP or payment work
discovered_terms_rejected.financial management: too broad to bound a search on its own
discovered_terms_rejected.management financial: one notice, and a word-order artefact

product_competitors.source: Gartner Magic Quadrant for Supplier Risk Management Solutions, 4 May 2026 (G00834117)
